content:
The neighbors start with 18 pink flamingos on Friday. On Saturday, they take back one third of the flamingos (6 pink), paint them white, and return them. Now there are 12 pink and 6 white flamingos. On Sunday, they add 18 pink flamingos, bringing the pink total to 30, while the white remains 6. The difference is 30 - 6 = 24.

Answer: 24
